author: Antigravity Biomedical Engineering Team
rationale_and_evidence: During post-review forensic verification of v24.0.0, matched control experiments demonstrated that adding the normalized margin separation composite score (AUC + 1e-4 * Margin) did NOT improve outer test AUC; rather, it dropped Binder outer performance from 0.8360 (pure inner-CV AUC) to 0.8300 (margin tie-breaking) and dropped unpenalized outer performance from 0.8240 to 0.8220. Furthermore, applying margin tie-breaking globally to historical models inadvertently modified 41 historical fold AUCs (e.g. dropping gpco_v23_tuned from 0.8260 to 0.8160). Consequently, this amendment decouples the rules based on outer diagnostic evidence.

primary_evaluation_target.tie_breaking_rule: Deterministic first-in-grid order (pure inner AUC, zero margin penalty)
primary_evaluation_target.rationale: Pure inner-CV discrimination objective without composite margin distortion

exploratory_diagnostic_comparator.primary_metric: 3-fold inner-CV mean fractional AUC + 1e-4 * Normalized Margin Separation
exploratory_diagnostic_comparator.status: Retained strictly as an exploratory diagnostic comparator to verify the negative effect of margin tie-breaking

historical_baselines.rule: Strict historical original rules (pure inner AUC for tuned models, unscaled original formulas)
historical_baselines.status: 100% frozen baseline reproduction verified (gpco_v23_tuned = 0.8260, v21_denoised_synergy = 0.8280, etc.)

scientific_qualification: This amendment was adopted following empirical observation of outer-fold diagnostic results. Therefore, the resulting performance of hmsco_v24_tuned (Binder 0.8360, Wielek 0.8433, Mendeley 0.7553, Macro 0.811556) is classified strictly as a reproducible development candidate finding rather than a blinded, pre-locked confirmation.
